title: Automatic Identification of Failure in Hip Replacement: An Artificial Intelligence Approach
summary: A machine-learning image classifier distinguished hip-replacement failure/loosening in radiographs. The result is retrospective diagnostic classification and does not establish improved patient outcomes.
